chunks: The pious will surely be in heaven,

key_terms.الْأَبْرَارَ: The pious or righteous ones, plural of barr

ai.seo_question: What is the ultimate fate of the righteous according to Surah al-Infitar?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse emphasizes the eternal spiritual and physical bliss of the *al-abrar* (the righteous), often linked to the Ahl al-Bayt and the faithful who uphold divine covenant. It serves as a comforting assurance of divine justice, contrasting the serene reward of the pious with the torment awaiting the wicked, reinforcing the concept of *adl* (divine justice) in the afterlife.
